svg.title: A restored snapshot must obey a later tenant closure
svg.desc: An old Shop A and Shop B data snapshot is restored after Shop A closes and Shop B changes a note. The restored store again contains Shop A's note and pending job and loses Shop B's newer edit. A separately preserved closure decision blocks Shop A reads and jobs while Shop B remains authorized but sees stale data. Reconciliation removes Shop A's resurrected active rows. Restoring the old closure record too would reopen the unsafe path.
svg.text: A backup is older than a closure decision.
Shop A note and job return in raw data.
B's old note returns; newer edit is lost.
Shop A: CLOSED → deny reads and jobs.
Remove A's active rows; cancel its job.
A's old ACTIVE status would reopen access.
Two local files; no distributed race or AWS restore test.
